businesses.business: Title insurance and real estate services

offering_description.value: Underwrites title insurance for property buyers, owners and mortgage lenders and provides escrow and closing services. It works through company offices and independent title agents and also provides appraisal, borrower verification and property data services to real estate and mortgage professionals.

primary_products.value: Owner’s title insurance policies; lender’s title insurance policies; property data and analytics software

primary_services.value: Escrow and settlement; title search and examination; property appraisal and valuation; mortgage credit reporting and borrower verification; digital closing and notarization

customer_segment.value: B2B: Mortgage lenders and servicers, independent title agencies, commercial property owners and investors, and real estate professionals; B2C: Homebuyers, home sellers, and homeowners refinancing a mortgage

end_markets.value: Residential real estate; commercial real estate; mortgage lending and servicing

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Premiums for owner’s and lender’s title insurance policies; service fees: Escrow, settlement, title searches, appraisals, credit reports, and borrower verification; subscription: Access to property data and analytics software
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Assesses property title risk and underwrites policies for property owners and mortgage lenders; service provider: Uses property records, appraisal data, and borrower information to support closings and mortgage origination; software / platform: Aggregates property records and market data for real estate investors and professionals
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with international operations including Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Title insurance, escrow and closing, appraisal and valuation, mortgage verification, and property data software

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent title agencies that issue policies backed by Stewart; own locations: Company-operated title and settlement offices; direct sales: Sales teams serving mortgage lenders and commercial real estate accounts; online: Web platforms for property data, mortgage services, and digital closings
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; own locations; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments license title insurers and agents, and federal real estate settlement rules apply to covered transactions.
